additional_info.subject: RE: ID0404244-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / SD 170004221] Logo FW version CRM:00643001255
additional_info.body:
Hi Sebastien,
If any charger coming from the factory has a power rating of 360/400kW, the LOGO firmware version should be 4.0. For chargers with a power rating below 300kW, the LOGO firmware version should be 2.7.
I’ve checked all three chargers on the SCB, and they appear to be functioning well with no critical error flags. Please let us know if you have any further questions to discuss. If not, we will proceed with closing this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
